Tens of thousands filled the Capitol Mall in St. Paul with a clear message:

NO KINGS.

In America, liberties matter and power belongs to the people.

Video

The sun is shining on Minnesota today! NO KINGS


The Minnesota Star Tribune (@StarTribune)

Minnesota State Patrol officials estimate more than 50,000 people have arrived at the Capitol for the #NoKings rally. Follow live updates here: bit.ly/4dOESt2

📸: Kyeland Jackson

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/StarTribune/status/2037971522690666783#m

Today, people across the country are marching for our democracy, saying NO KINGS in the United States! This morning I joined frontline Indivisible members in St. Louis Park. Many of us are now on our way to St. Paul!

Started the day in Roseville with the plumbers of Local 34 & 15, who are volunteering their time to help families in need. Their skill & generosity make a real difference. Thanks to AFL-CIO Pres. Liz Shuler & MN AFL Pres. Bernie Burnham for joining us.

Huge crowd at the Ukrainian American Community Center’s Lenten Friday Fish Fry and took this photo from the stage. Always inspired by the strength of Minnesota’s Ukrainian community. I’m proud to stand with them and with Ukraine. 🇺🇸🇺🇦
Sweet 16 tonight in Sacramento. Let’s go Gophers! 〽️ 🏀

I toured Plaza Del Sol today with Carlos Lopez and Alma Flores from the Latino Economic Development Center. Minnesota's small businesses and neighborhoods have been through a lot, and I'm looking forward to seeing this space open up and bring new opportunities to St. Paul!

Video

The DOJ’s weak Live Nation settlement showed why we need stronger antitrust enforcement.

I’ve introduced legislation to ensure antitrust settlements are fully reviewed and actually protect consumers.

digitalmusicnews.com/2026/03…

After voting late into the night, I caught the first flight out to make it to FIRST Robotics at the U of M this morning — as you can see from my shirt, they are doing a good job!

Incredible to see so many teams in action and innovating for the future.

The Senate unanimously passed our resolution honoring Master Sgt. Nicole Amor's memory and sacrifice.

She was a loving wife and mother of two.

She served our country for 20 years and was a beloved member of her community.

She will never be forgotten.

Great to see this bipartisan change in Minnesota—being a young parent should never be a barrier to serving our state. I led the effort in the U.S. Senate to allow newborns on the floor, but this is even more impressive.

I have a bill to ban federal officials from using prediction markets and stop this corruption.


Marshall Cohen (@MarshallCohen)

SCOOP: Someone made nearly $1m from dozens of remarkably accurate and well-timed bets about Iran, according to a new analysis of Polymarket data shared with CNN. They have 93% "win rate" for Iran bets over $10k since 2024, raising insider trading concerns cnn.com/2026/03/24/politics/…




— https://nitter.net/MarshallCohen/status/2036382923868275154#m

10-year-old Victor Greenawalt shielded his friend from gunfire during the tragic shooting at Annunciation Catholic School.

Now, he's been recognized with a Citizen Honor Award from the Congressional Medal of Honor Society.

Grateful to join him, his mother Annie, and his family.
Now it’s an 8% surcharge on packages. This war is making everything more expensive – from gas to packages to small business shipping – at a time when people can least afford it.

Minnesota is officially in the running to host the 2028 NFL Draft.

Can't think of a better place. #skol


Minnesota Vikings (@Vikings)

.@MNSportsEvents has officially submitted a bid to host the 2028 NFL Draft in partnership with @usbankstadium and the #Vikings.

📰: mnvkn.gs/4lNfOoi





— https://nitter.net/Vikings/status/2036835501030744372#m

New evidence ties Russian state-run companies to the forced abduction of Ukrainian children.

This cannot be ignored — we need to bring them home and hold the perpetrators accountable for these atrocities.

First New Mexico, now a case in California. Jury after jury is finding that social media platforms are harming our kids - exposing them to predators, addictive algorithms, and more.

We need rules of the road to keep our kids safe.

I called on the Administration to make E15 available to drivers this summer to curb rising fuel costs.

Today they announced they are doing just that. This is good for American consumers and farmers.

Next, we must pass my bipartisan bill to permanently allow year round E15.

State Sen. Zaynab Mohamed is a champion for her district and for Minnesota. I can’t think of a better leader for the 2026 Gabrielle Giffords Rising Star Award. Vote for Zaynab!

win.emilyslist.org/a/risings…

Hits close to home….

The seat that Ms. Gregory won had been held by a Republican who won by 19 percentage points in 2024! 

Florida Democrats Win Special Election in Mar-a-Lago’s District nytimes.com/2026/03/24/us/po… via @NYTimes
